notes: quantFileSha256 for MLX models is not a plain file hash: it is the sha256 of the text 'name:sha256' for each .safetensors file in the model folder, sorted by name, one per line; the per-file hashes are in weightFileSha256 of the run. Measured on mlx-omarchy 0.32.4.dev202610160529 (v0.7.33). The packaged build 0.32.4.dev202610050725 stalls on this model (the GPU does not advance for 10 s); the newer build fixes the rope-frequency path.
commands: mlx_lm.generate.generate_step(prompt=<8192 random ids, seed 292>, model, max_tokens=128, prefill_step_size=512)
method: Three rounds; per round and size: a prefill run (-p N -n 0) then a decode run at depth N (-p 0 -n 128 -d N); one repetition each, so every run is a raw value. Load gate under 1.0 before each run, 30 s pause between runs, stock clocks.
